## Generation prompt specification

One sample sheet of eight additional PETOA residents. Match the approved chunky 2.5-head JRPG style, short bodies, warm muted colors and dark pixel contours. All eight face directly forward, both eyes and shoulders visible. Four columns by two rows, complete heads and shoes, transparent alpha. A future inhabited city after nuclear war disrupted world order; repaired surviving materials and re-established social hierarchy. Top row: older male noble in indigo tailored coat with gold edging and family brooch; female noble in burgundy layered dress, cream collar, gloves and refined purse; prosperous mustached merchant in embroidered teal waistcoat with account book; female civil administrator with glasses, slate jacket, modest insignia and paper case. Bottom row: repair artisan in olive jacket and worn tool apron; seamstress with faded rust cardigan, cloth roll and canvas bag; poor elderly resident with patched layered coat and reused sack; poor young woman with gray-green patched jacket, scarf, repaired boots and reused basket. Show wealth through fabric quality, tailoring, ornament, maintenance and possessions. No modern executive suits, electronics, armor, weapons, crowns, ruins, begging poses or caricatured villain faces. No labels, borders or scenery.
